note: Adapted from the 12th species, “Eutermes (E.) borneensis Hav.”, in Holmgren (1913) Termitenstudien 4. Versuch einer systematischen Monographie der Termiten der orientalischen Region (Kungliga Svenska Vetenskaps-Akademiens Handlingar 50(2): 1–276); the original is in German; the alate section is Holmgren’s verbatim quotation of Haviland’s original English account, while the soldier and the worker are Holmgren’s descriptions. The original description is in Haviland (1898) Observations on termites; with descriptions of new species. In the original, the figures for the soldier’s head length with nasus, head length without nasus, head width and pronotum width are damaged in the OCR (about 1.1, 0.61, 0.37 mm) and were not entered; the plate (Tafel VII, Fig. 13) was not entered either.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate (after Haviland’s original account): body dark smoky brown, head chestnut brown, anterior part of meso- and metanotum, antennae and legs pale yellowish white; head oval; ocelli separated from the eyes by nearly one diameter; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 nearly as long as segment 2; pronotum 1 mm wide, anterior margin straight; posterior margins of meso- and metanotum each with two broad, obtusely angular lobes; wings 9 mm long, 2.5 mm wide, smoky brown, media nearer the submedia than the subcosta, giving off 2—3 branches at the apical quarter of the wing, submedia reaching to one fifth from the wing tip and with 8 branches; hind legs reaching the end of the abdomen. Soldier: head brownish yellow, with a nearly white patch on the nape; head pyriform, elongate, weakly constricted; nasus short and thick, conical; antennae 13-segmented; body length 2.7—3 mm. Worker: head broadly oval, slightly pentagonal, antennae 13-segmented, body length 3 mm, head width 0.72 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body dark smoky brown; head chestnut brown; anterior part of meso- and metanotum, antennae and legs pale yellowish white. Head oval. Ocelli separated from the eyes by nearly one diameter. Fontanelle rather indistinct. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 nearly as long as segment 2. Clypeus not projecting. Pronotum 1 mm wide, anterior margin straight. Posterior margins of meso- and metanotum each with two broad, obtusely angular lobes. Forewing buds only slightly larger than hind wing buds. Wings 9 mm long, 2.5 mm wide, smoky brown; media nearer the submedia than the subcosta, giving off 2—3 branches at the apical quarter of the wing; submedia reaching to one fifth from the wing tip, with 8 branches. Hind legs reaching the end of the abdomen.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brownish yellow, with a nearly white patch on the nape; abdominal tergites pale brown. Head with 1 pair of setae; abdominal tergites with microscopic hairs and a row of weak posterior setae. Head pyriform, elongate, weakly constricted; nasus short and thick, conical; frontal profile straight. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 longer than segment 2; segment 4 as long as segment 3. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin not incised. Body length 2.7—3 mm. Locality: Sarawak, Borneo (collected by Haviland).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head yellow, body nearly white. Head and abdominal tergites very sparsely hairy. Head broadly oval (slightly pentagonal); head suture and frontal gland indistinct; anteclypeus very short, rather raised. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2; segment 4 about as long as segment 2. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin not incised. Abdomen large, slightly inflated. Body length 3 mm; head width 0.72 mm.
